prospects.ai_hook: Home-market call. Ask for Sara, she runs the schedule. Lead with the history: Encyclopedia Dubuque traces Dimmer Brothers through four Dubuque addresses since 1971 - Garfield, Jonathan Lane, East 7th, now Davenport Street - and 55 years later there is still nothing to find online. Say: 'you're in the Encyclopedia Dubuque and you still don't come up on Google.' DO NOT mention licences (a second licence type shows inactive) and DO NOT open with reviews - they have zero reviews anywhere and it is their sore spot.

Ask for Mike Tobin, President. THE KEY MOVE: do NOT say 'you don't have a website' - they BOUGHT tobinbrothers.com and never built on it. Say 'you own tobinbrothers.com and it's sitting empty - I already built what belongs on it.' That is flattering instead of accusatory. Back it with 63 years: shop opened 1 January 1963 on NE Perry, AGC and MIMCA member. Alt number (309) 208-6124. DO NOT raise reviews (they have none) and DO NOT claim anything about their licence - IDPH status was never verified.

ASK FOR JENNIFER BUNJES - she is the named principal. Lead with the mismatch: a union shop bonded for public and private jobs up to $500,000, in the Blue Book since 2000 - and the whole company runs off an @mac.com email address with no domain at all. Say 'you're bidding half-million-dollar work off an @mac.com address.' If the main line is dead try (815) 703-5226. DO NOT name Don Bunjes (unconfirmed), DO NOT mention the Rockford Chamber (their listing lapsed), DO NOT lead with the MBE flag (self-reported), and DO NOT guess at their headcount - no source has one.

WARM, NOT COLD - Ricky knows Dallas personally; his wife Lauren cuts Ricky's hair. Different from a no-website prospect: they DO have a site, a single-page GoDaddy builder page. THE HOOK: there is no phone number anywhere on it. Say 'your website doesn't have your phone number on it.' Brand new operation (LLC, FB page and site all ~2025), unclaimed Birdeye listing, zero reviews, not ranking for any Dubuque landscaping search. Recommended entry: GBP Setup $250 + Landing Page $1,000, then GBP Authority $500/mo + Reputation Foundation $400/mo.
Their domain haierplumbing.com is live but still shows the hosting company's default 'UNDER CONSTRUCTION' page. 76 trucks, 60 drivers, no site. Lead with that, not a review-gap stat.
Only page on the internet with their name is a three-line Thryv template they didn't make. 19 commercial jobs running at $1.2M average. Lead with the Thryv page.
